name: term_neonate_1h
description: Literature reference values for a healthy term neonate (~3.5 kg) at ~1 h after an uncomplicated vaginal birth with delayed cord clamping (~1 min), room air, skin-to-skin. Grades: A = healthy term at that age, B = nearby age or related population, C = textbook/derived/carried from 72 h.

variables.label: Heart rate
variables.method: auscultation at 2 h, healthy term, any delivery mode
variables.notes: P50 126 at 2 h, thereafter 120-122; 1 h not sampled. Delivery mode not significant.

variables.label: Systolic BP
variables.notes: No hourly first-day BP found (Kitterman 1969 / Versmold 1981 lack abstracts). Day-1 median; day 4 70.

variables.label: Diastolic BP
variables.notes: Day 4 46.

variables.label: Mean arterial pressure
variables.notes: Kent reports oscillometric mean 48 (65/45 gives 52 calculated); 50 between. Day 4 54.

variables.label: Pulse pressure
variables.notes: Derived.

variables.label: Central venous pressure
variables.method: right atrial mean pressure, umbilical venous catheter
variables.notes: Healthy spontaneously breathing preterm infants (no term data; RAP did not correlate with birth weight or gestation). A-wave 4.9 (2-8). The 72 h textbook range 2-8 comes from sick infants.

variables.label: Pulmonary artery pressure, systolic
variables.notes: Indicative, from the ratio.

variables.label: Pulmonary artery pressure, mean
variables.notes: User decision 2026-10-25: near-systemic, ratio ~0.9, as the bidirectional duct implies (Skinner: bidirectional flow <-> ratio 0.88-1.22). Kang's 2 h values (77/63) exceed systemic pressure (indirect method) and are not used.

variables.label: Pulmonary artery pressure, diastolic
variables.notes: Reference only.

variables.label: LV end-diastolic volume
variables.notes: No volumetric data at 1 h; the 72 h CMR values do not apply with a 1.7x higher output.

variables.label: LV end-systolic volume
variables.notes: No volumetric data at 1 h; the 72 h CMR values do not apply with a 1.7x higher output.

variables.label: LV ejection fraction
variables.notes: No volumetric data at 1 h; the 72 h CMR values do not apply with a 1.7x higher output.

variables.label: RV end-diastolic volume
variables.notes: No volumetric data at 1 h; the 72 h CMR values do not apply with a 1.7x higher output.

variables.label: RV end-systolic volume
variables.notes: No volumetric data at 1 h; the 72 h CMR values do not apply with a 1.7x higher output.

variables.label: RV stroke volume
variables.notes: No volumetric data at 1 h; the 72 h CMR values do not apply with a 1.7x higher output.

variables.label: RV ejection fraction
variables.notes: No volumetric data at 1 h; the 72 h CMR values do not apply with a 1.7x higher output.

variables.label: Left ventricular output
variables.notes: Agata 1991 327 +/- 66 (n=34), Agata 1994 365 +/- 69 (n=23); falls to 301 at 4-8 h, 245-272 at 24 h, ~250 at 96 h. Includes the ductal left-to-right shunt.

variables.label: Right ventricular output
variables.notes: No reliable term RVO at 1 h; with a left-to-right duct RVO < LVO.

variables.label: SVC flow
variables.notes: 99 at day 1, 77 at day 3.

variables.label: Descending aorta flow
variables.notes: No data at 1 h.

variables.label: Cerebral blood flow
variables.notes: MCA flow volume at 1 and 4-8 h significantly lower than after 24 h (Agata 1994; no number).

variables.label: Intestinal (SMA) flow
variables.notes: No data at 1 h.

variables.label: Renal blood flow
variables.method: Doppler volume flow, LEFT renal artery only
variables.notes: Agata 1994 Fig 2: left renal artery ~32 (24 h) and ~37 (96 h) mL/kg/min. Single-vessel Doppler volume flows are implausibly high in absolute terms (see sma), so no numeric reference; the stable time course is the usable finding.

variables.label: Hepatic arterial / coeliac flow
variables.notes: Agata 1994 Fig 2: coeliac ~75 (24 h), ~72 (96 h) mL/kg/min. Same absolute-overestimation caveat; coeliac also feeds the stomach and spleen.

variables.label: Respiratory rate
variables.notes: No healthy-term RR at 1 h found. 72 h reference kept (Schmalisch day 7: 39.2 +/- 8.6. Fleming: median 44 at birth.)

variables.label: Tidal volume
variables.notes: No 1 h data; Vt rises from day 0 to day 1 (Lodrup Carlsen 1993). 72 h reference kept (A face mask + pneumotach adds +13% Vt and +30% MV (Schmalisch 2001).)

variables.label: Minute ventilation
variables.notes: No 1 h data; Vt rises from day 0 to day 1 (Lodrup Carlsen 1993). 72 h reference kept ()

variables.label: Inspiratory time fraction (Ti/Ttot)
variables.notes: No 1 h data; Vt rises from day 0 to day 1 (Lodrup Carlsen 1993). 72 h reference kept ()

variables.label: Peak tidal inspiratory flow
variables.notes: No 1 h data; Vt rises from day 0 to day 1 (Lodrup Carlsen 1993). 72 h reference kept (The model ramps muscle pressure linearly over inspiration; infants peak earlier.)

variables.label: Peak tidal expiratory flow
variables.notes: No 1 h data; Vt rises from day 0 to day 1 (Lodrup Carlsen 1993). 72 h reference kept ()

variables.label: Respiratory system compliance
variables.notes: Crs lower on day 0 than later (direction only, no number); reference only.

variables.label: Respiratory system resistance
variables.notes: Rrs also lower on day 0 (Lodrup Carlsen 1993). 72 h reference kept (Katier (4.6 wk) ~75-80 (range 39-199).)

variables.label: Functional residual capacity
variables.method: argon dilution FRC; TGV by plethysmography
variables.notes: FRC 23.1 at 4-6 h, 24.9 at 24 h (Lee); TGV 32.7 under 6 h (Milner). The 72 h model reads ~30 (TGV-like).

variables.label: Anatomic dead space
variables.method: nasal mask, added dead space method
variables.notes: No 1 h data; Vt rises from day 0 to day 1 (Lodrup Carlsen 1993). 72 h reference kept (Vd/Vt ~0.3-0.4.)

variables.label: SpO2 (pre-ductal)
variables.notes: Median 98.3 (88.7-100) 0-24 h (O'Brien). Pre/post-ductal gradient gone by 15 min (Mariani).

variables.label: pH
variables.notes: User decision 2026-10-25: grade C textbook (no quotable 1 h data; Weisbrot 1958, Koch & Wendel 1968, Jovandaric 2018 have values in tables only). Cord UA P10 7.21 (Dudenhausen 1997).

variables.label: pCO2
variables.notes: Respiratory compensation of the birth metabolic acidosis.

variables.label: Base excess
variables.notes: Cord UA base deficit P10 5.9 (Dudenhausen 1997).

variables.label: PaO2
variables.notes: No 1 h arterial data. 72 h reference kept (Capillary pO2 (Cousineau 45 +/- 7.5) is not comparable with arterial.)

variables.label: End-tidal CO2
variables.method: capnography; gap to PCO2 0 +/- 7 in healthy lungs
variables.notes: Expect EtCO2 ~ PaCO2.

variables.label: Mixed venous O2 saturation
variables.method: Fick: VO2 7.0, systemic flow ~300 (LVO minus ductal shunt), Hb ~18.5
variables.notes: Derived, not measured.

variables.label: Oxygen consumption
variables.notes: Hill & Robinson ~5 under 12 h in mostly low-birth-weight infants; lambs reach the postnatal level by 1 h. Kept at the 72 h value.

variables.label: Core temperature
variables.notes: Skin-to-skin rewarms 36.3 -> 37.0 over 1 h (Karlsson); SSC +0.15-0.28 C vs routine care.

variables.label: Plasma glucose
variables.notes: 1 h not lower than any later time (Hoseth); GLOW rises over 18 h to a 3.3 +/- 0.6 plateau to 48 h, P10 2.6. Skin-to-skin 60 mg/dL (3.3) at 75 min.

variables.label: Lactate
variables.notes: Falls to 1.4 (0.8-3.3) after 48 h.

variables.label: Hemoglobin
variables.notes: Derived from Hct.

variables.label: Hematocrit
variables.notes: 1-min clamping: 57.0 at 6 h (3 min 59.4, <15 s 53.5); Hct rises ~3.6 % over the first 4 h. User decision 2026-10-25: DCC values; the 72 h baby (49.5, mixed clamping) stays.

variables.label: Blood volume
variables.model_readout: sum of blood compartment volumes / weight
variables.notes: At birth: 115 mL/kg feto-placental minus the placental residual: early clamping 63-73, 3-min clamping 96-100 (Linderkamp 1992, Nelle 1995); 1 min ~85. Plasma then leaves at constant red cell mass as Hct rises (0.50 -> 0.55 at 1 h): 85 x 0.50/0.55 = 77; 3 min at 2 h: 100 x 0.50/0.63 = 79. Red cell mass 80 x 0.55 = 44 mL/kg joins the 72 h 0.49 x 85 = 42. User decision 2026-10-25 (was 92, C).

variables.label: GFR
variables.notes: Reference only; GFR low in the first day, doubles over 2 weeks.

variables.label: Urine output
variables.notes: First void by 6 h in 42 %, 12 h 76 %, 24 h 95 %.

variables.label: Ductal net left-to-right flow
variables.notes: 62 (95 % CI 43-82) shortly after birth, falling over 12 h; bidirectional at 2 h so net flow is lower than the L->R component.

variables.label: Foramen ovale
variables.notes: Shunt in 92 % within 1 h, predominantly L->R with a small diastolic R->L component in 64 %; reference only.

variables.label: Ductal right-to-left time
variables.notes: Bidirectional in 100 % at 2 h, 55 % at 6 h, 12 % at 12 h.

variables.label: SpO2 post-ductal
variables.notes: No gradient after 15 min.
